title: You can move around while ShopCoach drafts, nothing is added until Add Lines
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with a known number of findings (e.g. 5). Choose a target work order so drafting begins.
custom_steps:
1. Choose the destination and confirm drafting starts then, so navigation and drafting happen together.
2. While drafting, confirm the panel shows one skeleton row per finding, and the work order stays usable.
3. Cancel during drafting and confirm the work order is exactly as it was.
4. Confirm nothing reaches the work order until Add Lines is pressed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Drafting starts when the destination is chosen, so navigation and drafting happen together rather than one after the other.
  • While the lines are being drafted, the panel shows one skeleton row per finding.
  • The work order stays usable while the drafting runs.
  • Cancelling during the drafting leaves the work order exactly as it was.
  • Nothing reaches the work order until Add Lines is pressed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-R7: “Drafting will start when the destination is chosen, so the navigation and the drafting happen together rather than one after the other”
  • S15-R8: “While the lines are being drafted, the panel will show one skeleton row per finding, because the number of findings is known before the drafted lines are”
  • S15-R9: “The work order will stay usable while the drafting runs”
  • S15-R10: “Cancelling during the drafting will leave the work order exactly as it was”
  • S15-R15: “Nothing will reach the work order until Add Lines is pressed”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
